meta.what: the per-target model search, recorded candidate by candidate and fold by fold, so that a pruning rule can be replayed over real numbers instead of described
meta.objective: held-out R-squared, five-fold, pooled across the folds seen so far; the last entry of a curve is the candidate's final score

curve_scale.note: every policy, here and on the page, is replayed on these integers; the winning candidate's score is carried unrounded beside it

gate.note: ti/models.py will not use a model whose held-out R-squared is under this, so at a target where no candidate clears it the pruner changes the bill and nothing else

hansch.note: logP and its square are one descriptor in two columns

wide.note: logP and its square are one descriptor in two columns

schemes.random: folds drawn at random over molecules, so one chemical series can sit on both sides of the split
schemes.scaffold: folds drawn over Bemis-Murcko scaffolds, so a whole series is held out at once
